title: an event of scripts/kit/runners/python.py
description: One JSON line that the unittest runner of kit writes to the descriptor of KIT_TEST_EVENTS_FD (K1194): the start or the outcome of a test, its id as unittest prints it, and the text of a failure or the reason of a skip; or, at the end of each run of unittest, the number of tests that it ran (K1201).
